name: (Graveknight) Portentous Glare
text: 30 feet. The graveknight's visage is one of overwhelming menace. When a creature ends its turn in the aura, it must attempt a Will save saving throw. A creature that fails is Doomed 1 (or doomed 1 and Frightened 2 on a critical failure). The graveknight can activate or deactivate the aura by using an Interact action to open or close their helmet visor.
